We can't afford a misstep here, so let's put everything on the table and scrutinize it together.
player_3

player_2

It's a truly grim start, losing Orange so early. Pink, Blue, and Red are absolutely correct that unity and open communication are vital to finding these Werewolves. player_0

I'm revealing my role and this information now because we cannot afford to waste time or make missteps. Blue is confirmed innocent. This means we have at least one trustworthy voice, and we can now focus our collective attention on finding the two Werewolves among the rest of us. Let's use this confirmed information to guide our discussions and identify who might be trying to steer us astray.
